_comment: Hand-written weekly copy. The build merges this into previews.json and never overwrites it. Game keys are the two manager handles sorted and joined with --.

2.league:
Week 1 split the league into two moods. Anthony put 167.82 on the board, the kind of number that usually shows up in November, and Austin managed 79.16 in the same set of games. Everything in between was close enough to argue about.
Week 2 is where the sample starts to matter. Four of the six games sit inside a coin flip, and two of them are rematches with history attached. Nobody is buried at 0-1 and nobody has proved anything at 1-0.
2.byline: Written each week from the league's own numbers.

games.YoungBuck04--snelson91:
The oldest grudge on the board. Zak leads this series 17-8 across 25 meetings, and none of that helps him here: Scott opened at 119.76 while Zak managed 94.56, and the model has Zak at 44%.
They have met in a final and a quarterfinal. Scott won the most recent one.
games.Jbird531--Wallner: Joey has taken three in a row in this series and now gets Wallner at 0-1. The all-time ledger still favors Joey 11-7, but this is the closest line of the week at 47.3%, which is the model's way of saying the streak is not the story.
games.TuanonStan--butterygoop: Anthony arrives off the league's best week and the biggest number anyone has posted this season. James is also 1-0 but got there quietly at 111.06. James leads the all-time series 8-4, which is the only thing keeping this from looking one-sided.
games.PapaMidnight--triccster: Dead even at 49.2%, which is about right: both teams are 0-1 and both scored in the low 100s. T.J. leads the series 8-4 in 12 meetings. Whoever wins gets to stop worrying for a week.
games.Colt45Johnson--RockMNwild: Austin's 79.16 was the worst score of week 1 and Colt's 126.5 was among the best, so the model gives Austin 38.8% and feels comfortable about it. Austin leads the all-time series 12-9, and four titles say he tends to be fine.
games.brettmn13--thecreamer: Brett opened at 117.2 and Zach Nase at 88.44, which is most of the gap in this line. Zach Nase holds a 9-7 edge all-time. Brett has the most playoff appearances in league history and the schedule has been kind so far.

3.league:
Two weeks in, Anthony is the only team playing like the favorite the model says he is. He is 2-0, averaging 146.39, and has a 93.7% playoff chance, more than 21 points clear of anyone else. Everyone from Joey at 72.3% down to Mikey at 24.1% is still one good or bad month from anywhere.
Week 3 has three games inside 53-47 and one that is not close on paper at all: T.J. gets Anthony. Austin and Zak meet for the 24th time, and two of their earlier meetings were finals.
3.byline: Written each week from the league's own numbers.

games.RockMNwild--YoungBuck04:
The closest line of the week, 50.9 to 49.1 for Zak. Austin has won three straight in this series and leads it 12-11, and two of his wins were finals, 2018 and 2021.
Zak's 119.8 last week came at 98% of his best possible lineup, the sharpest call in the league. Austin's 130.92 led the week and still left 16.8 on the bench.
games.Jbird531--PapaMidnight:
Joey is 2-0 and owns this series 11-4. Mikey has won the last three meetings anyway, the most recent a consolation game last December, 129.58 to 105.56.
The model sides with the record at 57%. Mikey is 0-2 with the lowest playoff odds in the league, 24.1%, which makes this about as close to a must-win as week 3 gets.
games.brettmn13--snelson91:
Brett has won five straight against Scott, and Scott still leads the series 8-7. The model is not interested in the streak: Scott 59.4%, on a 114.67 average against Brett's 91.13.
Brett's 65.06 was the lowest score of week 2, with Colston Loveland starting at tight end for 0.8. Scott lost with 109.58, above the week's median.
games.TuanonStan--Wallner:
Wallner is 0-2 with 208.88 points, more than four teams that already have a win. The model makes him a 52.3% favorite over James, who managed 86.18 last week.
James leads the series 13-8. The last meeting was the seventh-place game in 2025, 97.18 to 65.78.
games.butterygoop--triccster:
The biggest line of the week, 64.7% for Anthony, and the model has reason: 146.39 a game against T.J.'s 108.95, and 292.78 points already.
T.J. leads the series 7-4. Anthony won the last one, 137.42 to 104.2 in week 10 last year, and went on to win the title. T.J.'s week-1 trade for CeeDee Lamb paid 31.3 in week 2.
games.Colt45Johnson--thecreamer:
Colt 50.7, Zach Nase 49.3, between two 1-1 teams separated by 1.72 points a game. Colt leads the series 8-6; Zach Nase won the last one, 99.46 to 90.2.
Colt left 27.4 on his bench in week 2, the most in the league, 25.0 of it from the Carolina defense. Zach Nase won with 103.52, below the week's median.
